name: Persona1
description: Spends significant time comparing universities and courses on various platforms, often reviewing the same information without making a decision.
current_behavior: UCAS course listings: This persona frequently compares options on UCAS.
University websites: This persona frequently compares options on university websites.
League tables: This persona frequently compares options on league tables.
PDF prospectuses: This persona frequently compares options on PDF prospectuses.
pain_points: Information Overload: Struggles to process and compare the vast amount of data available.
Decision Paralysis: Finds it hard to make a final choice due to constant comparison.
Redundant Research: Wastes time revisiting the same information without progressing.
evidence: Questionnaire responses indicating 'too much information on one page'.
Literature on information overload and decision paralysis.
Interview feedback highlighting repeated comparison behaviour.
reasoning: This persona emphasises reducing information density and focusing on key differentiators to guide your system's ranking and summarisation strategy.

name: Persona3
description: Selects courses according to broad interests instead of specific career objectives, and may misinterpret course titles or content.
current_behavior: Keyword searches: This persona frequently uses broad keyword searches.
Course descriptions on university websites: This persona frequently reads course descriptions.
YouTube and student blogs: This persona frequently watches YouTube videos and reads student blogs.
pain_points: Course titles lack clarity: Finds it hard to understand what courses truly entail.
Assumes prior domain knowledge: Struggles without a clear understanding of subject areas.
Struggles to map interests to concrete options: Has difficulty linking broad interests to specific courses.
evidence: Interview data showing uncertainty in course understanding.
reasoning: This persona supports the use of plain-language explanations and aligns interests with relevant courses.

name: Persona4
description: Handles decision-making under time pressure, often resulting from missed deadlines or delayed commitments.
current_behavior: Quick Google searches: This persona frequently uses quick Google searches.
UCAS Clearing pages: This persona frequently checks UCAS Clearing pages.
Peer recommendations: This persona frequently seeks advice from peers.
pain_points: Platforms assume long research cycles: Finds it hard to make quick decisions with existing resources.
Time pressure amplifies anxiety: Feels increased stress when making last-minute choices.
Difficulty identifying “good enough” choices quickly: Struggles to find satisfactory options under tight deadlines.
reasoning: This persona emphasises early value delivery and minimal friction, which supports your no-login, short-quiz approach.

name: Persona5
description: Consistently evaluates information reliability and verifies findings using multiple independent sources.
current_behavior: League tables: This persona frequently checks league tables.
Reddit / student forums: This persona frequently visits Reddit and student forums.
Official university statistics: This persona frequently reviews official university statistics.
pain_points: Distrust of marketing-heavy content: Skeptical of promotional materials from universities.
Difficulty identifying authoritative sources: Struggles to find reliable information.
Conflicting rankings: Finds it hard to reconcile differing league table results.
evidence: Literature on trust in educational platforms.
reasoning: This persona requires transparent reasoning and explainability rather than persuasive language.
